run_generate_requirements_txt: run the script to generate a requirements.txt from artifacts in the dist directory
run_generate_requirements_txt_for_tox: run the script to create a requirements.txt so tox tests use local dist artifacts instead of PyPI
run_generate_requirements_txt_zip_artifa: run the script to write all zip artifacts from dist into requirements.txt
run_generate_requirements_txt_wheel_arti: run the script to write all manylinux2014 x86_64 wheel artifacts from dist into requirements.txt
review_generate_requirements_txt: review the script that generates requirements.txt from dist directory artifacts for tox/pip testing
